messages.author: 453ddfeccaf29bbb
messages.subject: command.hpp refactor and bbvb
parts:
hi folks,

dustin and i are eager to continue working on 
even more experimental extensions of advi, 
some of which we may or may not want to 
include into Stan proper. 

as such, it would be really convenient for us
to merge feature/bbvb into develop and then
create smaller, self-contained branches off of
develop for each of the new things we want to try.

dustin and i just looked at the command.hpp move
to cmdStan. we can update that branch with 
the additional lines required for advi. (it's self
contained; a trivial modification.)

how should we proceed with this? could we 
merge feature/bbvb before the command.hpp move
or is that a bad idea?

cheers
alp
